text.jp:
ダグザに暮らす一般的な民
様々な出自や立場の者がいる
text.official_en:
A member of Dagda's common
folk, who hail from diverse
backgrounds and positions.

text.jp:
名門の家と名を受け継ぎ
王や領主として民を導く者たち
text.official_en:
A scion of a prestigious house
given authority over the people.
text.real_en: People who inherit the name of a prestigious house and lead others as kings or lords.

text.jp:
ダグザを統べる神々の一柱
人智を超えた力を持つ
text.official_en:
A god who rules over Dagda. Has
power unthinkable to humans.

text.jp:
剣、斧、籠手といった武器を
巧みに使いこなす者
攻撃力に優れる
text.official_en:
Can deal devastating damage with
weapons such as swords, axes,
and gauntlets.
text.real_en: Fighters skilled with swords, axes, and gauntlets. They excel in attack power.

text.jp:
槍の扱いを得意とする者
盾と鎧で身を固め
守備力に優れる
text.official_en:
A spear-wielder who dons armor
and holds a shield for maximal
defense.

text.jp:
剣と弓とを使い分け
戦場で獲物を狙う軽装な戦士
技と速さに優れる
text.official_en:
Adept with both swords and bows.
Draws upon dexterity and speed to
stalk foes.

text.jp:
魔道を用いて、時に味方を癒やし、
時に敵と戦う者。魔力に優れる
text.official_en:
Uses magic to both heal allies and
harm foes.
text.real_en: Magic users who sometimes heal allies and sometimes fight enemies. They excel in magic.

text.jp:
飛駝に乗った騎兵
障害物を跳び越えることができる
text.official_en:
Mounted upon an ornius, this class
can leap over obstacles.

text.jp:
剣の扱いに特化した戦士
素早い剣さばきで敵を攻撃する
text.official_en:
A sword specialist who metes out
swift strikes to foes.

text.jp:
鍵開けを行える盗賊
森林を軽快に動くことができ、
探索にも力を発揮する
text.official_en:
A thief and expert lockpick. Can
also move swiftly through forests
for scouting.

text.jp:
全身を鎧で覆われた歩兵
厚い装甲で、味方の盾となる
text.official_en:
This class, clad in thick armor, acts
as a sturdy shield for allies.

text.jp:
斧の扱いが自慢の荒くれ者
高い威力の一撃で敵を打ち倒す
text.official_en:
This rough-and-tumble class cuts
down foes with powerful axe
strikes.

text.jp:
弓の扱いに優れる兵士
離れた場所への攻撃と
飛行する敵を得意とする
text.official_en:
Facility with a bow allows this
class to take down distant foes and
flying units.

text.jp:
籠手の扱いに秀でた拳闘士
軽快な攻撃で敵を翻弄する
text.official_en:
A scrappy, gauntlet-proficient
brawler. Can confuse foes with
light attacks.
text.real_en: Gauntlet specialists who keep enemies off balance with swift attacks.

text.jp:
黒魔法を専門とする呪術師
様々な攻撃魔法を扱うことができ、
装甲の厚い敵を得意とする
text.official_en:
A spellcaster specializing in black
magic that pierces the heaviest
of armor.

text.jp:
白魔法を専門とする祈祷師
魔法で味方の回復と攻撃を
行うことができる
text.official_en:
Can use white magic to heal allies
and sling attacks at foes.

text.jp:
飛駝の扱いに長けた騎兵
障害物を跳び越えることができる
text.official_en:
Mounted upon an ornius, this
armored class soars over obstacles.

text.jp:
馬に乗って戦う騎兵
高い移動力で戦場を駆ける
text.official_en:
This horse rider can swiftly gallop
across the battlefield.

text.jp:
有翼馬に乗り、空を翔ける騎兵
移動力に優れ、魔法に強い
text.official_en:
Riding atop a pegasus, this class
soars through the sky and easily
resists magical attacks.
text.real_en: Cavalry riding winged horses through the sky. Highly mobile and resistant to magic.

text.jp:
戦闘馬車に乗って戦う特殊な騎兵
戦車の突撃や、弓で敵を蹂躙する
敵の攻撃を避けることができない
text.official_en:
Can fire a bow and charge at foes,
crushing them. Cannot avoid
attacks.
text.real_en: Special cavalry fighting from war chariots. They trample enemies with charges and bow attacks, but cannot evade enemy attacks.

text.jp:
剣の精神を重んじ、修行した剣豪
素早い剣さばきで敵を攻撃し
時に必殺の一撃を狙う
text.official_en:
Highly trained and attuned to the
spirit of the sword. Deals swift,
fatal damage.
text.real_en: Swordsmen trained in the spirit of the sword. They attack with swift swordplay and sometimes aim for a critical blow.

text.jp:
鍵開けを得意とする仕事人
森林を軽快に動くことができ
探索の際にも活躍する
text.official_en:
A skilled lockpick who moves
nimbly through forests, making the
class a useful scout.

text.jp:
槍の扱いに熟達し、
白魔法も扱うことができる衛士
攻守の均整が取れた戦いをする
text.official_en:
Handy with spears and white
magic. Excels in both offensive and
defensive fighting.

text.jp:
強固な鎧に身を包んだ重装歩兵
厚い装甲で敵の攻撃を受けとめ、
味方を守る壁となる
text.official_en:
Thanks to thick armor, this heavy
infantry class is like a sturdy wall
defending allies.

text.jp:
斧の技を磨き抜いた斧闘士
鍛え上げた腕力で繰り出す
高い威力の一撃で敵を打ち倒す
text.official_en:
Easily crushes foes with strength
and well-honed axe skills.

text.jp:
斧の扱いに熟達し、黒魔法も
使うことができる特殊な斧戦士
臨機応変な戦い方ができる
text.official_en:
An axe wielder who can also use
black magic. Quite flexible in battle.

text.jp:
弓の扱いに精通する狙撃手
離れた場所への攻撃と
飛行する敵を得意とする
text.official_en:
Able to deliver attacks from long
distances. Particularly punishing to
flying enemies.

text.jp:
高度な黒魔法を扱う魔道士
攻撃魔法を巧みに操る
装甲の厚い敵を得意とする
text.official_en:
A black-magic user who deals high
amounts of damage, cutting
through heavy armor.
text.real_en: Mages wielding advanced black magic. They excel at offensive spells against heavily armored enemies.

text.jp:
高位な白魔法を扱う聖職者
魔法での回復や補助を得意とする
text.official_en:
Draws on religious faith and the
power of white magic to heal and
support allies.
text.real_en: High-ranking clergy who specialize in healing and supporting allies with white magic.

text.jp:
馬を乗りこなす精鋭騎士
高い移動力で戦場を駆ける
text.official_en:
An elite who gallops across the
battlefield with alacrity, punishing
foes from horseback.
text.real_en: Elite knights skilled at riding horses. They can cross the battlefield with great mobility.

text.jp:
装甲で身を固めた重装騎士
重装と騎兵の特徴を併せ持つ
text.official_en:
A heavily armored class that is
talented in riding and defense.

text.jp:
馬上から弓を射る森林騎士
移動力が高く、森も得意とする
text.official_en:
A knight who shoots at foes from
horseback and can even navigate
wooded areas.

text.jp:
白魔法と黒魔法を操る魔法騎兵
武器は扱えず、呪歌を覚える
text.official_en:
A cavalry class that can use white
and black magic but not weapons.
Plays spellsongs.
text.real_en: Mounted mages who wield white and black magic but cannot use weapons. They learn spell songs.

text.jp:
黒魔法を扱える魔法飛駝兵
障害物を跳び越えることができる
text.official_en:
Perched on an ornius. Springs over
obstacles to pepper foes with
black magic.

text.jp:
飛竜に乗り、空を翔ける竜騎兵
移動力と戦闘力が高い
text.official_en:
Flies through the sky on a bau.
Is skilled in combat and has
excellent mobility.

text.jp:
戦象に乗って戦う特殊な騎兵
象の突撃や、鼻撃で敵を掃討する
敵の攻撃を避けることができない
text.official_en:
Rides on an elephant. Attacks by
charging and swinging the animal's
trunk. Cannot avoid attacks.

text.jp:
剣の道を極めし剣聖
目にもとまらぬ鋭い剣技で
必殺の一撃を繰り出す
text.official_en:
The swordmaster has grasped the
way of the blade, delivering deadly
blows with blinding fury.
text.real_en: Sword saints who have mastered the way of the blade. They deliver critical blows with sharp sword techniques too fast for the eye to follow.

text.jp:
影の世界で生きる暗殺者
解錠、探索はお手の物
森林を軽快に動くことができる
text.official_en:
This lockpick, scout, and assassin
lives in the world of shadows. The
class also moves nimbly in forests.

text.jp:
剣と黒魔法で敵を翻弄する魔剣士
解錠、探索を得意とし、
森林を軽快に動くことができる
text.official_en:
Toys with foes using swords and
black magic. Can also pick locks
and move nimbly in forests.
text.real_en: A magic swordsman who outwits foes with swords and black magic. Skilled at picking locks and scouting, and moves nimbly through forests.

text.jp:
槍を極め、白魔法も扱う聖槍兵
戦闘は勿論、味方の援護など、
様々な局面で活躍する
text.official_en:
A spear master who uses white
magic. Excels in both combat and
support roles.

text.jp:
斧の戦いを極めし闘将
あり余る体力と腕力を持ち、
前線に立って活躍する
text.official_en:
A maven in the art of axe fighting,
Strong, resilient, and effective on
the front lines.
text.real_en: A master of axe combat with immense stamina and strength, excelling on the front lines.

text.jp:
圧倒的な装甲を誇る守護の要
移動と機敏さは捨て、その分
堅牢な守りで敵の攻撃を遮る
text.official_en:
What this armored class lacks in
agility is made up for with sheer
defensive ability.
text.real_en: The backbone of defense, clad in overwhelming armor. Sacrifices mobility and agility to block enemy attacks with an impregnable defense.

text.jp:
弓の扱いを極めた射の達人
遠方の敵を狙い、正確に射貫く
飛行する敵を得意とする
text.official_en:
With keen accuracy, this class can
take out distant foes. Specializes in
downing fliers.

text.jp:
篤き信仰を胸に拳を振るう戦僧
強力な打撃力を誇り、同時に
白魔法を扱うことができる
text.official_en:
Faithful and fervent. Boasts fierce
power as well as the ability to use
white magic.
text.real_en: A warrior monk who fights with fists and fervent faith. Delivers powerful blows and can also use white magic.

text.jp:
黒魔法を極めし魔術師
高威力の攻撃魔法を多彩に操り
敵に甚大な被害を与える
text.official_en:
With mastery of a wide variety of
black magic, this class can rain
devastating damage on foes.

text.jp:
白魔法を極めし賢者
魔法で傷ついた味方を癒やし
戦いを後衛で補佐する
text.official_en:
A sagacious class that heals and
supports allies from the rear flank
using white magic.

text.jp:
白魔法と黒魔法を修めし術士
より遠くの敵を攻撃でき、
より多くの味方を救ける
text.official_en:
A user of both black and white
magic. Can attack from a distance
and save more allies.

text.jp:
騎乗戦闘を極めた神金騎士
人馬一体の動きで
縦横無尽に戦場を駆ける
text.official_en:
A golden knight with a mastery of
mounted combat, this class is one
with the horse.
text.real_en: A knight clad in deiform gold who has mastered mounted combat, riding as one with the horse across the battlefield.

text.jp:
剣と黒魔法を操る魔剣騎士
馬を駆り、敵を一刀に伏す
text.official_en:
Skilled with black magic as well as
swords. Can kill with a single slash.
text.real_en: A mounted magic swordsman who wields swords and black magic, felling foes with a single stroke.

text.jp:
全身鎧に身を包んだ重甲騎士
重装と騎兵の特徴を併せ持つ
text.official_en:
A heavily armored knight who
rushes into the battle on horseback.
text.real_en: A fully armored knight combining the characteristics of heavy infantry and cavalry.

text.jp:
弓の扱いに長けた弓騎士
移動力が高く、森も得意とする
text.official_en:
A skilled archer and horse rider,
highly mobile and able to navigate
wooded areas.

text.jp:
白魔法を扱える魔法騎士
移動力が高く、仲間を援護する
text.official_en:
A highly mobile magic knight. Can
use white magic to heal allies.
text.real_en: A highly mobile magic knight who uses white magic to support allies.

text.jp:
白魔法と黒魔法に秀でた魔法騎士
武器は扱えず、呪歌を覚える
text.official_en:
Though unable to use weapons,
this class can use black and white
magic, as well as spellsongs.

text.jp:
有翼馬を乗りこなす精鋭飛行騎士
移動力が高く、魔法に強い
text.official_en:
An elite flying knight who flies on
a pegasus. Is highly mobile and
resistant to magic.
text.real_en: An elite flying knight who rides a winged horse. Highly mobile and resistant to magic.

text.jp:
黒魔法を操る飛行魔法騎士
移動力が高く、魔法に強い
text.official_en:
Highly mobile and magic resistant.
Flies over the battlefield using
black magic.
text.real_en: A flying magic knight who wields black magic. Highly mobile and resistant to magic.

text.jp:
飛竜を乗りこなす熟練の竜騎士
移動力と戦闘力が高い
text.official_en:
With excellent combat skills and
mobility, this class strikes fear in
foes from the skies.
text.real_en: An experienced dragon knight who rides a flying dragon, excelling in mobility and combat.

text.jp:
戦場で華麗に舞う舞踏家
美しい踊りで仲間を元気づけ、
再行動させることができる
text.official_en:
With graceful, fluid dancing, this
class cheers up allies, motivating
them to take further action.
text.real_en: A dancer who moves gracefully across the battlefield. Their beautiful dancing cheers on allies, allowing them to act again.

text.jp:
剣に生き剣に死す、神衛の剣士
その刃に断てぬ物なし
text.official_en:
A protector to the gods, this class
lives by the sword. There is
nothing their blade cannot cut.

text.jp:
神意により戦場に厄災を蒔く者
闇を暴き、人々に福音をもたらす
text.official_en:
Sows disaster through divine will,
exposing the darkness and clearing
the way for better things.
text.real_en: Sows calamity on the battlefield by divine will, exposing darkness and bringing people good tidings.

text.jp:
不浄なる神敵を貫く神槍士
聖なる魔法により苦境の者を守る
text.official_en:
A spear wielder who pierces
impure foes and uses holy magic to
protect others.
text.real_en: A divine spearman who pierces the impure enemies of the gods. Uses sacred magic to protect those in need.

text.jp:
無窮の力を持つ戦いの申し子
烈斧にて神の征く道を切り拓く
text.official_en:
A child of battle who possesses
infinite power. Carves a path for
the gods with an axe.

text.jp:
全てを打ち砕く神拳の持ち主
その拳を時に癒やしの掌に変え、
弱き者を救う
text.official_en:
With a divine fist that pummels
foes and heals allies, this class is a
protector of the weak.

text.jp:
神の御業を写し、魔法を統べる者
白と黒の理を極めた至尊の魔道士
text.official_en:
A master of black and white magic.
Rules over magic and mirrors the
deeds of the gods.

text.jp:
神聖なる舞を納めし舞巫子
その美芸は神の御心をも癒やす
text.official_en:
A mystic who performs sacred
dances. Can soothe the hearts of
the very gods.

text.jp:
神速で戦場を馳せる護神騎士
その姿、地を走る雷がごとし
text.official_en:
A swift protector who looks like a
flash of lightning racing into battle.

text.jp:
多節の外殻を持つ大型の虫
洞窟などの湿潤な場所を好む
稀に「虫真珠」を落とす
text.official_en:
A large, segmented insect that
thrives in moist caves and
occasionally drops insect pearls.
text.real_en: A large, segmented insect that favors damp places such as caves. Rarely drops insect pearls.

text.jp:
鎧のような殻を持つ大型の虫
尾の鋭い針に毒を持つ
肉はエビのようで美味い
text.official_en:
An insect with a thick shell and
sharp, venomous spines. Its
delicious meat tastes like shrimp.
text.real_en: A large insect with an armor-like shell and a venomous stinger on its tail. Its meat tastes delicious, like shrimp.

text.jp:
ダグザ全土に生息する獰猛な狼
背中に縞模様を持ち
素早い動きで獲物を襲う
text.official_en:
This swift, ferocious wolf is found
throughout Dagda. It is named for
the stripes on its back.
text.real_en: A ferocious wolf found throughout Dagda. It has stripes on its back and swiftly attacks its prey.

text.jp:
世代を重ね、飛翔能力を得た蜥蜴
バウとは種が異なるが一見似ており
「バウモドキ」とも呼ばれる
text.official_en:
A lizard that has evolved to fly.
It is not a bau, but looks similar to
one, earning the name "False Bau."

text.jp:
異形な姿をした海に棲む獣
肉食で、人間の肉を狙って
船を襲うこともある
text.official_en:
This ocean-dwelling creature has
a strange appearance and an
appetite for human flesh.
text.real_en: A strange-looking, carnivorous sea beast that sometimes attacks ships in search of human flesh.

text.jp:
強靱で凶暴な熊
アトラ山付近によく生息しており
古代の伝説の巨人に例えられる
text.official_en:
This vicious bear, which inhabits
the area near Mount Atla, is often
likened to giants of legend.

text.jp:
俊敏で凶暴な熊
体躯は小柄だが爪や牙に毒を持つ
洞窟に生息する姿がよく見られる
text.official_en:
An agile, ferocious bear, small in
stature, but with venomous claws
and fangs. Often found in caves.

text.jp:
砂漠に生息する巨大な虫
長い体を砂中に沈め
近づいてきた獲物に襲いかかる
text.official_en:
A mammoth arthropod that slinks
under the desert sand, attacking
any prey that comes close.

text.jp:
見上げるほど巨大な人型の魔物
知能は高くないが、道具を使う
text.official_en:
A huge humanoid who one must
crane their neck to see—smart
enough to use tools, but little else.
text.real_en: A towering humanoid monster of low intelligence that nevertheless uses tools.

text.jp:
古の技術で造られた人型の兵器
斥候、護衛、戦闘に用いられる
text.official_en:
This automaton, made with ancient
technology, excels in scouting,
guarding, and combat.

text.jp:
古の技術で造られた巨大人型兵器
超重装甲かつ高出力を誇る
text.official_en:
With its incredible armor and high
energy output, this enormous
automaton is formidable indeed.
text.real_en: An enormous humanoid weapon built with ancient technology, boasting extremely heavy armor and high power output.

text.jp:
神の力で作られた神殿の守護者
内部に結界を展開する機構を持ち
味方の防御力を高める
text.official_en:
A temple guardian forged by divine
power. It can create barriers that
bolster its allies' defenses.
text.real_en: A temple guardian made through divine power. Contains a mechanism that creates barriers to strengthen allies' defenses.

text.jp:
「海王」とも称される海の支配者
水中を恐ろしい速さで泳ぎ、
巨体を宙に踊らせ敵を押しつぶす
text.official_en:
Known as the Sea Tyrant, this
huge beast swims at amazing speed
and goes soaring to crush its foes.
text.real_en: Known as the Sea King, this ruler of the seas swims at terrifying speed, leaps into the air and crushes foes beneath its enormous body.

text.jp:
巨大な蛇のような姿の魔獣
地中から頭だけをもたげ
群で獲物に襲いかかる
text.official_en:
A serpentine monster that raises its
head from the ground to attack
prey in packs.

text.jp:
複数の頭を持つ大型の魔獣
魔獣ディガンマの本体にあたる
text.official_en:
A large, many-headed monster—
the body that the digamma, its
heads, are attached to.
text.real_en: A large, many-headed monster that forms the main body of the demonic beast Digamma.

text.jp:
巨大に成長する野生の鳥
大空を舞い、地を這う獣や虫、
そして、人を捕食する
text.official_en:
This wild bird grows to enormous
size and preys on insects as well as
animals—human or otherwise.

text.jp:
天を覆うほどの巨翼を持つ鳥
不吉な姿と鳴き声をしており、
冥府の神の遣いとも囁かれる
text.official_en:
A huge bird feared for its ominous
appearance, size, and cry. It is said
to be an envoy of the underworld.
text.real_en: A bird whose enormous wings seem to cover the sky. Its ominous form and cries have led to whispers that it serves a god of the underworld.

text.jp:
正体不明の妖しい影
禍々しい魔の波動を放つ
text.official_en:
A mysterious, unidentified shadow
emitting sinister vibrations.
text.real_en: A mysterious, unidentified shadow that emits sinister waves of magical power.

text.jp:
魔神バロールが作り替え
己が肉体とした冥界の要
text.official_en:
A cornerstone of the underworld
remade by Balor into his own body.

text.jp:
鍛冶の神クレールに作られた
自動で動く兵士型の人形
text.official_en:
A soldier automaton crafted by
Credna, the Spark of the Forge.
text.real_en: An autonomous, soldier-shaped puppet made by Claire, god of smithing.

text.jp:
動く人骨の魔物
死した人間の成れの果て
text.official_en:
A monster composed of animated
bones—this is what has become of
a deceased human.

text.jp:
蘇った死体の魔物
死後、不浄に侵された人の骸
text.official_en:
The resurrected corpse of an
impure person.
text.real_en: A reanimated corpse, the remains of someone defiled after death.

text.jp:
不浄に侵され、眠りを妨げられた
巨大な魔獣の死体
体から腐臭を放ち、毒を持つ
text.official_en:
The corpse of a Demonic Beast,
corrupted and startled from sleep.
It is as venomous as it is odorous.
text.real_en: The corpse of a huge demonic beast, defiled and disturbed from its rest. It reeks of decay and is venomous.

text.jp:
謎多き異形の獣
巨大な体躯と恐るべき力を持つ
text.official_en:
This grotesque beast is feared
for its gigantic body and 
fearsome strength.
text.real_en: A mysterious, grotesque beast with an enormous body and terrifying strength.

text.jp:
ダグザのもう一つの名
凄まじき力を持った空舞う巨竜
text.official_en:
Dagda—a giant, soaring dragon of
incredible strength.
text.real_en: Another name for Dagda, a mighty flying dragon of tremendous strength.

text.jp:
魔神バロールのもう一つの名
冥界の支配者たる畏ろしき魔竜
text.official_en:
Balor—the fearsome, demonic
dragon who rules the underworld.
text.real_en: Another name for Balor, the fearsome demonic dragon who rules the underworld.

text.jp:
マーズのもう一つの名
炎の如く猛々しき勇壮なる竜
text.official_en:
Mars—the fierce, heroic dragon
who burns with a fiery passion.
text.real_en: Another name for Mars, a gallant dragon as fierce as fire.

text.jp:
ライラーのもう一つの名
奇怪な身体つきをした禍々しき竜
text.official_en:
Lyrah—a sinister dragon with an
unusually shaped form.
text.real_en: Another name for Lyrah, a sinister dragon with a strangely shaped body.

text.jp:
正体不明の巨大な肉塊
繭のようにも見える
text.official_en:
A huge, unidentifiable mass that
resembles a cocoon.

text.jp:
左右に伸びる角を持つ牛
家畜にもなるが、野生のものは
気性が荒く、人を襲うことがある
text.official_en:
A bovine creature with horns on
both sides. It may be kept as
livestock but tends to act unruly.
text.real_en: A cow with horns extending to either side. It can be kept as livestock, but wild ones are fierce and may attack people.

text.jp:
牙の生えた野生の豚
食欲旺盛で何でも食べ
ダグザの過酷な環境を生き抜く
text.official_en:
A tusked, porcine creature that will
eat anything. It survives in Dagda's
harshest environments.
text.real_en: A voracious, tusked wild pig that eats almost anything to survive Dagda's harsh environment.

text.jp:
広く家畜とされる草食の獣
搾った乳は飲料や乾酪となる
肉は固いが好んで食される
text.official_en:
This herbivore can have its milk
used for beverages and cheese.
Its meat, though tough, is popular.
